scope: Four profiles (q3, ql, rtcw-sp, rtcw-mp) against one shared writable home with the same client: config persistence, one-way QL migration, protocol state, module API and native-cache separation.

client.platform: Windows x86, RelWithDebInfo, RTCW and WolfET development gates on

command: python scripts/probe_profile_isolation.py --client meson/build/win32-gaps/fntech3.exe --q3 <Quake 3 Arena> --ql <Quake Live> --rtcw <Return to Castle Wolfenstein> --output .tmp/profile-isolation

q3.command: +set com_gameProfile q3 +set fs_basepath C:\Program Files (x86)\Steam\steamapps\common\Quake 3 Arena +set fs_homepath E:\Repositories\fnTech3\.tmp\profile-isolation\shared-home +set fs_game  +set r_fullscreen 0 +set r_mode 3 +set in_mouse 0 +set in_joystick 0 +set in_nograb 1 +set s_initsound 0 +set com_steamIntegration 0 +set fs_skipWorkshop 1 +set cl_webuiEnable 0 +set cl_renderer glx +set logfile 2 +set net_port 0 +set com_introplayed 1 +exec probe-round1-q3.cfg
